settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Store details, currency, checkout rules and notifications.
settings.countryHint: Two-letter country code, for example US.

store.title: Store
store.description: Shown on invoices, emails and the storefront footer.
store.name: Store name

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Prices are stored in US dollars. Turkish storefront visitors see Turkish lira converted at this rate.
currency.rateHint: Orders freeze the rate at checkout, so changing it never alters past orders.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.backordersHint: Stored for later. Overselling is not supported by the current stock model.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.description: Rules applied when customers place orders.
checkout.guestHint: Let customers order without creating an account.
checkout.prefixHint: Up to 8 letters, numbers or dashes.
checkout.freeShippingHint: USD subtotal that unlocks free shipping. 0 turns it off.
checkout.reservationHint: How long stock is held for an unpaid order.

seo.title: Search engines
seo.description: Fallback title and description for pages without their own.

emails.title: Email notifications
emails.description: Emails are written to the outbox until a mail provider is connected.
emails.adminAddressHint: Where new order alerts are sent.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance.hint: Shows a maintenance message to customers. Staff keep access to the admin panel.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.subtitle: Methods, rates and the countries each one serves.
shipping.empty: No shipping methods yet. Customers cannot check out without one.
shipping.deleteBody: Past orders keep the method they used.

form.codeHint: Short identifier such as standard, express or pickup.
form.name: Name
form.countriesHint: Two-letter codes separated by commas, or * for everywhere.
form.perKgHint: USD per full kilogram above the first.
form.freeOverHint: USD subtotal that makes this method free. Leave empty for never.
form.activeHint: Inactive methods are not offered at checkout.

tax.title: Tax
tax.subtitle: Sales tax rates by country and region.
tax.note: Tax is added on top of prices. When several rates match, the most specific one wins: a region rate beats a country rate.
tax.empty: No tax rates yet. Orders are charged without tax.
tax.deleteBody: Past orders keep the tax they were charged.

form.name: Name
form.regionHint: State or province. Leave empty for the whole country.
form.appliesToShippingHint: Adds the rate to the shipping charge as well.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: People who can sign in to the admin panel.
staff.permissionsNote: Staff can manage the catalog, inventory, orders, reviews, coupons, banners and pages. Administrators can also refund orders, change settings, manage staff and read the audit log.
staff.inviteBody: They receive an email with a link to set their password.
staff.resetBody: They receive an email with a link to choose a new password.
staff.enableBody: They will be able to sign in again.
staff.disableBody: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you enable the account again.
staff.deleteBody: The account is removed. Their past actions stay in the audit log.

form.name: Full name
form.roleHint: Administrators have full access. Staff cannot refund, change settings or manage people.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}. Every admin change is recorded here.

emails.title: Email outbox
emails.subtitle: Every email the store has sent.
emails.note: No mail provider is connected, so emails are saved here instead of being delivered. Password and invite links in these emails give access, so this page is for administrators only.
